header.name: User Experience Design and UI Design (UIUX)
header.description: This project based course introduces students to the UX Design Process and and familarizes them with the principle of UI Design.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Identify and describe the core principles, processes, and methodologies that form the foundations of UX Design, including user-centered design processes and research techniques.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Conduct UX research effectively by applying appropriate methods to gather meaningful insights and user requirements.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Create wireframes and low-fidelity prototypes that demonstrate practical application of UX principles, effectively communicating design intentions for both physical and digital user interfaces.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Evaluate design effectiveness through critique and user feedback, and communicate design concepts and rationale clearly and professionally, particularly in social applications and contexts.

lecture_topics: UX Methods and Design Process (Problem and Solution Space)
User Interface Design Fundamentals and Laws of UX
Case Study: Designing for Social Good. Example studies

resources.title: Kurniawan, S., 2004. Interaction design: Beyond human–computer interaction by Preece, Sharp and Rogers (2001), ISBN 0471492787. Universal Access in the Information Society, 3, pp.289-289.
Additional Readings from Design Studies, Interactions (ACM), and proceedings of CHI, DIS, CSCW conferences.
